reference.title: Scenario 2 — Admonition inside a table cell

section.p:
Consider a where one of the
cells contains a
element rather than a plain

element.

entry.codeblock:
Setting Notes
Production Mode

Do not modify this value in production.

<simpletable> <sthead> <stentry>Setting</stentry> <stentry>Notes</stentry> </sthead> <strow> <stentry>Production Mode</stentry> <stentry> <note type="warning"> Do not modify this value in production. </note> </stentry> </strow> </simpletable>

section.p: Result: When an admonition element appears inside a <td> cell, the converter wraps the content in a <note> element and places it inside the corresponding DITA <stentry> or <entry>. The admonition does not break out of the table cell boundary — it is contained within the cell and rendered as inline note content within that cell.
